$comment: Entries of one listing in the order of the contract (compareFileEntries in shared/src/protocol/files.ts): each entry sorts before every later one. Read by the comparator's test (shared/test/files-order.test.ts) and by the app's FileEntry.listingOrder (FileEntryOrderTests in RarogContract). Names are JSON escapes, so no editor changes their Unicode form: U+03AC and U+0391 U+0301 are canonically equivalent once lowercased, yet their UTF-16 code units differ.
